## My request:
For Entire, judges need a working checkpoint link and checkpoint ID. Just mentioning Entire in the README won’t demonstrate it.

- Capture a genuine coding session, commit the change, and check that Entire lists its checkpoint.
- Review the recorded session for secrets/private data before sharing.
- Push and check “entire status” for checkpoint synchronization.
- Open the commit in Entire and verify both Sessions and Changes load. Add that checkpoint link + ID to your README/submission, and show it in the demo.
- Test the link signed out or from another account so you know judges can access it.

I’ll verify Entire’s checkpoint capture and sync flow, record a genuine coding change, review the session for private data and test the resulting link while signed out. I’ll add the checkpoint ID and link to the demo evidence once judges can access them.

Entire is installed, but automatic checkpoint pushing is disabled and its two existing checkpoints are only local. I’m checking the public sharing flow before publishing a session so the judge link will be usable.

I’ll add a verification script that checks the commit trailer, the local checkpoint and the remote checkpoint hash. That will give the demo repeatable evidence of synchronization. I’ll keep the old transcripts private and share only a reviewed portion of this coding session.

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: [repository]/scripts/verify-entire-checkpoint.sh
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Verify one reviewed checkpoint without uploading unrelated session history.
+revision=${1:-HEAD}
+checkpoint_remote=${2:-origin}
+commit=$(git rev-parse --verify "${revision}^{commit}")
+checkpoint=$(git show -s --format=%B "$commit" | git interpret-trailers --parse | sed -n 's/^Entire-Checkpoint: //p')
+if [[ ! "$checkpoint" =~ ^([0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}|[0-9a-f]{12})$ ]]; then
+  printf '%s\n' 'Missing or ambiguous Entire checkpoint trailer.' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ ${#checkpoint} -eq 26 ]]; then
+  checkpoint_ref="refs/entire/checkpoints/${checkpoint: -2}/$checkpoint"
+else
+  printf '%s\n' 'Legacy checkpoint: inspect its storage with the Entire CLI.' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+local_hash=$(git rev-parse --verify "$checkpoint_ref" 2>/dev/null) || {
+  printf '%s\n' 'Checkpoint is missing locally.' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+remote_result=$(git ls-remote --refs "$checkpoint_remote" "$checkpoint_ref" 2>/dev/null) || {
+  printf '%s\n' 'Could not read the checkpoint remote.' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+remote_hash=${remote_result%%$'\t'*}
+if [[ "$local_hash" != "$remote_hash" ]]; then
+  printf '%s\n' 'Checkpoint is not synchronized with the remote.' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+printf 'Commit: %s\nCheckpoint: %s\nSynchronized: yes\n' "$commit" "$checkpoint"
*** End Patch"));

content.text: The script passed checks for a missing remote checkpoint, a synchronized checkpoint and a missing commit trailer. I also caught a capture problem: attaching this long-running chat reused its October 7 checkpoint. I removed that trailer and am preparing a clearly labeled excerpt of today’s actual coding work.
